headline: Going Commando matches more Yeedil and Aranos Prison code
summary: New matching C code covers Yeedil, Aranos Prison, shared level routines and the hero's held object. Matching means the C compiles to the same bytes as the original game. The end-of-day USA v1.01 report records 7,152 of 8,578 functions matched, with 3,674,960 of 5,525,784 code bytes matched.
highlights: A batch matches 44 functions across Yeedil, Aranos Prison and shared levels on USA v1.01 (#381).
Object-slot selection and positioning the hero's held object move from near misses into matched C (#370, #371).
Further matches cover Dobbo, Snivelak and other level routines, alongside retained reconstructions for unfinished work (#372, #373).
